main_text.p: Socin. Regul. & Fallent. 52. ex-cept.5.Objici denique possent alias ab iis quæ subsequuntur. Cui-vis licitum est propriâ aucto-ritate bona amissa repetere, at-que vindicare, si per judicemBarbof. Princ. & axiom. jur. in litt.num. 22. Massa contra usum da-telli p. mi-hi 81[?]. ibi-demque Castien. justitia haberi non poffit. Igi-tur etiam poterit fama vindi-cari, quando copia non eft magistratus, qui eam vindicet. Ast non cenfetur effe copia, fi nolit magistratus illatam injuriam, vindicare, aut fi differre malit, ne unquam injuriarum proceffus ad finem perducatur. Paria enim funt in jure aliquem nolle, & non poffe. Ut fi dicat magistratus fe non poffe honorem læsum reparare, id privato cuivis in propria liceat causa[?].
Nam quod aliter aut alio medio expediri non poteft, eft necessarium & sufficit, ut illo fis[?] alleg.experiatur medio, quo poteft. Necessitas enim legi non subjacer. Et. sæpe facit licitum,

page.notes: The lower-left marginal note is only partly visible; its reading "Dacelli" or "Datelli" and the number "81" are uncertain. The final word "Castien." may continue on the next part. The margin note "fis alleg." is uncertain in its first letter. The word "jacer" is printed as such (for "jacet"), left as printed. The final word of the page is a catchword, not part of the text.
